item.title: Credit cards are killing culture and jobs
item.description: With talk of electronic euros on the horizon, the lack of cash on the streets is killing small businesses, hostelry sector employees and street artists.

item.title: Trump: Spain is a loser
item.description: “It doesn't play as a team, and we're not going to play as a team with Spain either.”

item.title: International airline body accuses Spain airport authority of ‘inappropriate alarmism’ about air safety to justify tax increases
item.description: The airline association has argued that airlines are not looking for ’extremely cheap” infrastructure, as the president of Aena claims, but rather a cost structure that reflects the reality of the market.

item.title: It has been 33% wetter than normal in Spain since October, Mallorca gets another soaking this week
item.description: The rains caused by storm Regina have left accumulated rainfall records in the last 24 hours of 43 litres per square metre in parts of Mallorca.

item.title: Two U.S. Navy helicopters land at Palma airport as military activity in Mallorca airspace intensifies
item.description: Giant Galaxy transport planes have overflown the island twice this week.

item.title: Four Mallorca beaches rank among world’s safest
item.description: The report assessed 70 beaches across various continents, placing the Balearics prominently for travellers seeking secure destinations for families.

item.title: Why Brits pack tea bags for holidays - and where you can buy them in Spain
item.description: In 2025, a fascinating survey by Go.Compare revealed just how attached British travellers are to their home comforts — and tea bags topped the list. Conducted among over 2,000 adults, the study found that one in five Brits admitted to packing tea bags when travelling abroad, often accompanied by biscuits, baked beans, or even a favourite pillow. It seems that for many, a proper cup of tea is as essential to a holiday as sunscreen or a swimsuit.

item.title: Fire breaks out on ferry heading for Palma, 15 people require medical assistance
item.description: Total of 169 passengers (155 adults, 10 children, and 4 infants) and 46 crew members were travelling aboard the ship.

item.title: Why Mallorca is so important for the U.S. military
item.description: The strategic importance of the Balearic Islands, which had diminished after the Cold War, has surged again due to the current geopolitical climate.

item.title: Mallorca weather for Saturday, March 7
item.description: No weather alerts for Mallorca at present, but occasional spells of heavy rain are likely.
